reviews.text: It's expensive and the staff aren't friendly.
I adopted two baby rats from this pet shop… it cost me over $300 because the rats had serious respiratory problems and lice….
The cute kittens on site hehehe and the staff are cool!
I don't understand why we're still in the business of caged birds.
Compelete stock, barely a product can't be found

Worst dog store ever with employees that doesnt love animals or care about them. Im there 1 minute late from closing time with my dog trying to buy dog food  and she is just there on her computer shaking her head at us. Mind you i even called when i was on my way to tell her im almost there please wait for us my dog needs food. How do you work at animal store when you dont care about animals? I know its  my fault for not buying in advance but when your freezer stopped working while youre at work and all your raw fog food is wasted when you return from work what can you do except for run to the only open pet store in town tonight?

If youre that blue haired girl reading this. Dont work at a pet store when you have no love and care for animals. Youre lying to urself if you think you love animals.

Go somewhere else to buy ur dog food if you can. But this place obviously is just in it for the money and dont actually care about animals. Who knows what else they do behind closed doors to cut costs or whatever.

I get my dog's nails trimmed at Animal Expert and I'm always impressed by their gentleness and professionalism. The team really takes the time to put my dog ​​at ease, even when he's a little nervous. The service is quick, safe, and always done with a smile. You can tell they genuinely love animals and know what they're doing. I highly recommend them to any owner looking for a reliable and caring place for nail care!
For all pet owners: you have to go! They have everything your four-legged or two-winged friend needs! Plus, they're super friendly ☺️ 👍🏼👍🏼 …

Fantastic neighborhood pet store! 🐾 It's a far cry from the impersonal service of big-box stores! Here, the employees truly take the time to help and advise us based on our needs. The service is warm, friendly, and personalized.

There's an incredible selection of pet products—honestly, the variety is impressive. You can find everything in one place, and you can tell the employees really know their products.

It's so nice to support a business where customer service is still a priority. I highly recommend it! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Don’t bother getting stuff delivered by them.
Placed order on Thursday being promised delivery by Saturday. Just called and was told there’s no way to receive and refund and the delivery isn’t coming till Monday earliest.
As well they charge for delivery even though on website it’s free after a certain amount.

We loved our experience here. The young ladies at the front desk were so kind and they seem to really love and care for their animals and truly want to find a good home for them. Even before entering, there was a cat sunbathing in the window and we were allowed to play and pet him. He was so adoreable. The young lady Elia, even offered us and allowed to see, pet and play with a very funny and playful cockatiel. He was lovely, we really did want to take him with us right then and there.
I was looking for some CDB supplements for my dog and even though they didn't have that, they had some similar hemp supplements in chicken, beef and salmon favors, which are pretty good and so far so good!
Merci beaucoup! :)

I came in on Monday to inquire about cat nail trimming, and they told me to come back on Tuesday or Wednesday without an appointment. I arrived on Wednesday with my cat (despite the cold weather), and they told me I should have called ahead because no one else could do it.

Very disappointing experience. The place looked unclean, smelled bad, and the cages were extremely small. My pet came back stressed and trembling. Staff didn’t seem trained or interested. I would never leave my animal here again.

I bought boots for my dog, and the saleswoman assured me I'd get a refund if they didn't fit. That same evening, when I tried them on her, they were much too big, even the XS size. So I went back to the store the next day, but they were out of smaller sizes. I asked for a refund, but they refused! This is unacceptable! Because of this deplorable service, lack of communication, and disastrous customer service, you've lost a customer.
